name: New Earth-rise
credit: In the 2026 Artemis test mission, the astronauts recreated the famous "Earthrise" photo. The Earth appears like a 'Cresent Sun', rising from the horizon of the Moon. In reality, this scene is actually 'sideways' and the Earth does not appear to move for anyone on the surface of the Moon. The effect is achieved when the spaceship radially flies by the Moon. The Moon being 'tidally locked' means we only see one side of it from Earth, but that also means that the Earth is always in the same place in the 'sky' for anyone on the surface of the Moon. There's two references to Breakout 71. I know you can see the first, but can you see the second? Level by D.V.
